# Frotz, Inc.

> Frotz, Inc. is the umbrella for a family of open-source (apps under GPLv3, shared libraries under MIT), browser-native tools for writing, building, inspecting, and shipping interactive fiction for the Z-machine, the virtual machine behind the classic 1980s text adventures. Every tool runs in the browser, works offline, and keeps files on the user's machine. Shared code is published on npm under the @frotzinc scope.

"Frotz, Inc." is a playful fiction: there is no company, just one part-time developer. It is not affiliated with the Frotz interpreter or its authors. The name comes from the spell in a 1983 text adventure that makes an object give off light.

## Products

- [Frotzsmith](https://frotzsmith.com): Now available. A browser IDE for Inform 6 and ZIL. Compiles to Z-machine and Glulx with the real compilers running in WebAssembly, supports Standard Library and PunyInform profiles, and includes a skein test runner.
- [Frotzlens](https://frotzlens.frotzinc.com): Now available. Drop in a story file to inspect its header, object tree, dictionary, grammar, routines (as cross-referenced disassembly), and strings; fully symbolic when given Inform's debug output. A browser successor to txd and infodump.

## Planned

- frotzpack: Release packaging. Blorb, iFiction metadata, cover art, and generated feelies (maps, manuals, hint booklets) from the story file.
- frotzlint: Formatter and linter for Inform 6 source, runnable via npx or on save inside Frotzsmith.
- frotzcheck: Headless regression testing for story files in CI; diffs transcripts against a golden copy. Ships as a GitHub Action.
- frotztrace: Z-machine debugger with breakpoints, watches, and object-tree inspection; source-level stepping inside Frotzsmith.
